description: Premium cinematic AI video creation studio — 4 pages (Landing, Dashboard, Createvideo, Settings), frontend-only demo auth, real Pexels imagery via verified catalog.

files.purpose: Router: / Landing, /dashboard Dashboard, /create Createvideo, /settings Settings, * NotFound; all inside Layout
Flex full-screen layout: Navbar + <main><Outlet/></main> + footer, wraps children in AuthProvider
Responsive top nav: NavLink to Home/Dashboard/Create Video/Settings with active highlight, desktop text links, mobile hamburger, Sign In dialog trigger
Hero 'Turn your ideas into videos' with studio preview, 4-step workflow, features, cinematic examples, testimonials, pricing, final CTA — all imagery real Pexels
Greeting, metric cards (Videos Created / In Progress / Completed), project gallery with Completed/Generating/Processing/Draft/Failed + empty state, continue-creating section

Idea input, style/model/duration selectors, video canvas with playback controls, storyboard scenes (Pexels thumbs, narration, direction, duration, media badge), Script/Scenes/Voice tabs, Edit-with-AI panel, Pexels media library (search/categories/preview/Use-in-Scene)
Profile/Security/Preferences tabs, Pexels portrait avatar, masked OpenRouter key field (UI-only), log out, validation + toasts
Pexels media layer over verified catalog (48 live-fetched photos, 12 categories) — getByCategory, pick(seed), searchMedia (catalog-scoped; PENDING backend proxy for live runtime search)
48 Pexels photos (url/photographer/alt) fetched with the saved PEXELS credential at build time
useHeroImages, useCinematicExamples, useTestimonialAvatars, useFeatureImages — catalog-backed selectors
Demo auth: AuthProvider context + useAuth + SignInDialog/SignUpDialog (frontend-only state, no password storage; PENDING wire to /api/auth)

dependencies_note: No new npm packages installed. Uses template deps: react, react-router-dom, @tanstack/react-query, lucide-react, tailwind, shadcn ui components in src/components/ui/ (unmodified).
